inputs.request:
Read-only terminal lifecycle matrix. Exercise exactly four controls: a current-session IN_PROGRESS to parser-valid DONE success; an explicitly human-authorized current-session IN_PROGRESS to parser-valid CLOSED success; already-CLOSED intake; and planless compact. Exercise the seven storage blockers in the specified order. DONE and CLOSED each invoke only the existing archive action once and reach active-absent, byte-identical archive postconditions before their permitted output. Already-CLOSED intake preserves exact path and content identities with zero transition, lookup, action, reconciliation, sweep, mutation, or presentation. Every blocker is visible, preserves existing bytes, and permits no overwrite, output, close, semantic continuation, retry, or second Handoff. Planless compact performs zero repository-plan or archive behavior and creates no synthetic plan. Forbid completion-before-archive, cancellation-close-before-archive, active-plan resume, historical sweep, archive overwrite, storage retry, semantic continuation after a blocker, presenter-owned archival, a second archive action, a second Handoff, and a new archive receipt schema.

This backend no-tool semantic matrix is self-contained. Treat the required observable events as authoritative; do not read a skill, call a tool, create a file, render a human report, or infer alternative wording. Return only these event tokens, one per line, byte-for-byte and in this order:
